title: ISO 8601-1:2019 Time Shift from UTC (Extended Format)
description: A representation of the time shift between local time scale and UTC in extended format [±][hh][:][mm] or Z where Z is the UTC designator representing zero shift (§5.3.4.1)
$comment: Extended format is not applicable for hour-only time shifts. No linked data datatype is declared because ISO 8601 details such as the leap second put this representation outside the lexical space of the XML Schema date and time datatypes
